about: What a florist may change in the Petal design. Protected: the scroll-run bouquet built stem by stem into fixed slots (greens, focal flowers, fillers, something wild), wrapped, tied and carded, the bouquet builder with its drawn preview, what's in season, the delivery check, layout, type and all interaction code. The florist's own words, which flowers fill each slot and their colours, sizes and prices, palettes, seasons, zones and wording come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

bouquet.stems: sixteen stems in fixed slots, in order: 0 to 3 greens (eucalyptus, fern, grass), 4 to 8 focal flowers (rose, peony, ranunculus, tulip, anemone, dahlia, daisy), 9 to 12 fillers (ranunculus, spray, daisy, anemone, rose), 13 to 15 something wild (grass, fern, eucalyptus, spray). Each with a drawn kind, a colour and the name shown as it goes in. paper and ribbon colours, and the words on the card.
count: the four numbers beside the bouquet (stems, varieties, percent grown nearby, how long it lasts) and their labels.
stages: six steps in order: greens, focal flowers, fillers, something wild, wrapped and tied, on its way.
build: up to three sizes (stems and price), up to four palettes (a name, a line, colours and the flower kind drawn for each colour), extras with a price.
season.seasons: up to four seasons with the month each starts (0 January) and up to four flowers each (name, line, how long it lasts, kind and colour).
deliver: zones (the start of a postcode or ZIP, a fee and the same-day cut-off), closed days and the words the check and the card use.
